title: Money
description: A monetary amount in a single currency. amount is a decimal string with at most the currency's ISO 4217 minor-unit digits (2 for GBP, 0 for JPY, 3 for KWD) and an optional leading minus. Never a JSON number.

amount.description: Decimal string. Scale must not exceed the currency's minor units. No exponent, no thousands separators, no currency symbol.
